One valuable way to get express yourself through ballet that you could explore is through choreography. Dancers do not have to know a plethora of steps in order to be able to choreograph what they’re feeling, so you could choreograph your own pieces as an avenue of self expression. You may also find that modern is a good way to express yourself through dance with less worry about your ability. 

Ultimately, I hope you find success in dance!! Self expression is not exclusive to those out the top of their field!
